name: squish-memorybench
description: MemoryBench benchmarking framework for Squish - Tests against LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and Convomem datasets

scripts.bench: bun run src/index.ts run -p squish -b locomo
scripts.bench:longmem: bun run src/index.ts run -p squish -b longmemeval
scripts.bench:convomem: bun run src/index.ts run -p squish -b convomem
scripts.bench:all: bun run src/index.ts compare -p squish -b locomo,longmemeval,convomem
scripts.test: bun run src/index.ts test -p squish -b locomo
